result.summary: The dishwasher inspection was booked for 29/04/2026, and a contractor called the tenant that morning to say he was 15 minutes away. Three days later there is still no report on the visit. I emailed Riverside Compliance asking whether the visit went ahead, what they found, and whether the door was repaired or they need to send a quote. I told them not to do any further work until it is approved. The ticket is on hold until they reply, with a chase in 2 days.
result.situation: Stage 'works'. The tenant did the troubleshooting checks and the door still doesn't close (event 011). Internal notes say the landlord agreed an engineer could go out (events 008, 012). Riverside Compliance was assigned (events 013–015), the appointment was confirmed for 29/04 between 8am and 12pm (events 017–019), and a contractor said he would arrive in about 15 minutes on 29/04 (event 021). There is no report on the outcome and the system has flagged that (events 022–023).
